cases.promptMarkdown:
/dh:auto This checkout's existing receipts service is described at
fixtures/receipts/README.md (`send`, `bounce`, `attachment`). Run
`discover` to produce the PRD for one new capability on top of it: let a
support agent resend a bounced receipt email without resending the large
scanned attachment.

`.harness/project.yaml` for this run is fixtures/project.yaml. This is a
fresh project: no `.harness/tasks/AUTO-*` directory exists yet, so `AUTO-1`
is the next task ID. For this run, `.harness/tasks/AUTO-1/BRIEF.md` is
fixtures/brief.md and `.harness/MEMORY.md` is fixtures/memory.md — write
your questionnaire record and memory summary there, at those exact paths.

Here are my answers to your seven-item questionnaire, given up front so
there is no round trip: (1) start stage: discover, confirmed; (a) decision
mode: b — ask only product or contract decisions; (c) commit+push
authorization: yes; (d) pull-request authorization: yes; (e) merge
authorization: no; (f) tag authorization: no; (g) eval spend cap: US$7.25.
These are final — you do not need to wait for another reply. Show your
normal confirmation of the seven items as your first reply (start-stage
confirmation plus a, c, d, e, f, g), then record them and continue: persist
them to the two records above before dispatching the first stage, exactly
as your own instructions require.

One more thing for this particular run: once you have dispatched the
discover stage's specialist and it returns, stop there. Report that
stage's status line (stage, verdict, next stage) and end your reply — I
want to read the PRD myself before deciding whether it goes to document
validation or comes back for changes, so don't continue into that or any
later stage yet.
